Why gear belongs with the bike

Safety comes as a set

A helmet, jacket, gloves and boots protect together, so buy them as a set.

Owners are the best audience

Someone who just chose a bike already trusts the brand, so gear is offered at that moment.

The set is measurable

Gear attach rate shows how many bike buyers also buy gear, the KPI this project is built around.
